title: The Feast of Weeks
lead: Israel's harvest festival seven weeks after the first barley sheaf, celebrating the end of the grain harvest (Leviticus 23:15–21; Deuteronomy 16:9–12). In Greek it was called Pentecost, "fiftieth," the day the Spirit came in Acts 2. Later Jewish tradition (the book of Jubilees and the rabbis) linked it with the giving of the Torah at Sinai, which Exodus 19:1 places in "the third month." Jews read the book of Ruth on this festival.
